description: Start a maintenance plan for a job's customer (owner or office). AI can draft the priced lines for one term; the owner approves them before the plan is sent. The first term's invoice is created now (and sent if send_first is true). When a term ends, the next term's invoice is created automatically and sent if auto_send is on. With visits_per_term, each term also gets that many service due dates (see services.listDue), so the shop knows when each covered visit is due; schedule the actual visit with visits.create as usual.

kind.description: item (default), fee (trip charge, disposal, card fee) or discount. For a discount, enter the amount off as a positive unit_price_minor.

taxable.description: Counts toward tax when the quote or invoice has a tax rate. Default true.

tax_rate_id.description: Tax rate each term charges. Leave out for the shop default rate; null for no tax.

visit_title.description: What each visit is called, for example "Furnace tune-up". Default: the plan name and "visit".

visits_per_term.description: Visits the plan covers each term, for example 2 for two tune-ups a year. Each term gets that many service due dates, spread evenly from the term's start. Default 0.

name: maintenance_createPlan
